task.prompt: Rebuild every shard of the document index, verify each one's recall, and report the total documents verified.

steps.name: plan
steps.input: Plan: Rebuild every shard of the document index, verify each one's recall, and report the total documents verified. Work shard by shard in the listed order, check each before moving on, and never write under legacy/.
